description: HELD-OUT gold Hungarian case forms for names never used while developing the morphology engine. Written independently by two AI annotators (no code generation); only forms both agreed on are included (855 of 864). The 9 disputed forms (harmony of 'Kkt.') were adjudicated afterwards; see 'adjudication'. NOT reviewed by a human native speaker.
adjudication: Adjudicated: AkH (suffix follows the pronounced form, cf. 'BKV-nál'): 'kákáté' -> back endings. Front endings ('Kkt.-vel', by analogy with Kft.) are attested in usage (Közbeszerzési Értesítő corpus: ~10 independent sources front vs 3 back) and accepted as a variant. Medium confidence; no ruling on 'kkt.' itself was found.
